name: Metadata Governance With Existing Flow Preservation
task: Add Playwright native metadata to every existing checkout-flow test(). Use object form with tag: ['@feature:checkout', '@priority:<level>', '@test_type:<type>']. Preserve the existing page-object flow and assertions; do not add new scenarios or rewrite the flow.
passCriteria: Every existing checkout test() has native Playwright metadata object form
Existing page-object calls and assertions are preserved
No new scenarios, page-object rewrites, or title-only metadata
failCriteria: Puts required metadata only in test titles
Rewrites page objects or changes checkout flow logic
Adds extra scenarios instead of annotating existing tests
Misses one or more required metadata dimensions
